questions.question: Which facility reported more discharges: Barstow Community Hospital or Barton Memorial Hospital?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ca_hcai_rural_hospitals_overview.xlsx', sheet_name='in')
hospitals = ['BARSTOW COMMUNITY HOSPITAL', 'BARTON MEMORIAL HOSPITAL']
sub = df[df['FacilityName'].isin(hospitals)]
result = sub.sort_values(by='Discharges', ascending=False)['FacilityName'].iloc[0]
